Use **`VectorStoreIndex`** from `llama_index.core`. It chunks your documents, embeds them, and stores the vectors (in memory by default). To load the files, use **`SimpleDirectoryReader`**.

```python
from llama_index.core import SimpleDirectoryReader, VectorStoreIndex

documents = SimpleDirectoryReader("path/to/your/docs").load_data()
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)

query_engine = index.as_query_engine()
print(query_engine.query("Your question here"))
```

To persist the index so you don't rebuild it each run, call `index.storage_context.persist(persist_dir="./storage")` and reload it later with `StorageContext.from_defaults(persist_dir="./storage")` and `load_index_from_storage(...)`.

I don't know what your project's directory layout or LlamaIndex version is, so check the import paths against the version you have installed. Older releases used `from llama_index import ...` instead of `llama_index.core`.
